root_cause: On ARM64 cross-compiled CPU builds, the KleidiAI-accelerated matmul-with-compressed-weights implementation is not selected for this specific parameter combination (dynamic DYNAMIC_QUANTIZATION_GROUP_SIZE with a bias-fusing post-op), falling back to a generic 'undef_f32' executor instead of a 'kleidiai'-named one. This is the same intermittent KleidiAI executor-selection issue previously recorded in pattern 5c9adec102201520 (first seen 2026-11-13), now recurring a third time across unrelated PRs (#39266, #39548, #39963), confirming it is unrelated to the current PR's Python/PyTorch-frontend changes and is a pre-existing flaky ARM64 CPU-plugin test.
reproduction_steps: On an aarch64 Linux CPU build with KleidiAI enabled, run: ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter='*smoke_MatMulCompressedWeights_Kleidiai*CompareWithRefs*data_shape=[?.?.?]_([1.4.16].[10.16.16])_weights_shape=[16,32]*i4*f32*dynamic*full*empty*DYNAMIC_QUANTIZATION_GROUP_SIZE*fusingBias*' repeatedly; failure is intermittent and may require several runs/different scheduling to reproduce.
recommended_actions: Investigate src/plugins/intel_cpu/tests/functional/custom/subgraph_tests/src/classes/matmul_weights_decompression.cpp:168 and the underlying KleidiAI executor-selection logic to determine why the bias-fusing + dynamic-group-size case sometimes falls back to undef_f32 instead of the kleidiai implementation.

Consider marking this specific parameterization as disabled/known-flaky in the CPU functional test suite until the executor-selection race/condition is fixed, to stop blocking unrelated PRs in the merge queue.
This PR (#39963) is unrelated to the failure; re-running the failed job or re-queuing should let it merge.
prevention_strategies: Add deterministic executor-selection logging/tracing around KleidiAI matmul decompression so flaky selection can be root-caused instead of only observed as an assertion failure; add a retry/quarantine mechanism for this specific parameterized test case.
historical_context: Same signature (5c9adec102201520) previously recorded twice: 2026-11-13T07:09:24Z (run 43378018632, PR #39266) and 2026-11-13T19:24:42Z (run 43486543645, PR #39548). This is the 3rd occurrence overall (count=3), but the prior two occurrences are more than 12 hours before this run, so the 12-hour recurring-escalation threshold is not met by this run alone.
